investigation.title: Remote Agent Creation Blocked by Swarm Agent Quota Exhaustion (HTTP 409)
investigation.summary: All three remote-agents eval checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed at 2026-06-16T15:45:17–21Z with an identical HTTP 409 response from POST /api/agents, carrying the swarm error "conflict: agent quota exceeded: limit is 100". Because the agent creation call is the first step in every remote-agents probe, the quota rejection prevented any evidence (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) from being collected, causing a complete contract gap across all three checks.
investigation.rootCause: The production-api swarm backend rejected POST /api/agents with HTTP 409 and error code "conflict: agent quota exceeded: limit is 100". The eval probe account's organization has reached the swarm's hard limit of 100 remote agents. Because createAgent() (infra/evals/status/run-status-probes.mjs, line 1339) is called before any evidence is written, the 409 terminates the probe immediately, leaving all required evidence fields (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) absent and failing every downstream assertion in the expected-output contract (infra/evals/status/check-expectations.json, lines 182–187). This is an eval infrastructure failure caused by a resource-limit condition in the production swarm API; no user-traffic or incident signals are present in the supplied evidence.
